title: feat(spec)!: retire PackageDependency.optional and AppManifest.dependencies, the two unread dependency spellings (ADR-0141 D8)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVH2vvDXVdAZoD8eV8xc6m4)_

Fixes #25792

This is card item 6, the last open item (ADR-0141 D8 items 2 and 3). Items 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7 landed in #25986 and #26054, and item 3 in #26123.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：依赖声明的两种「无人读取」拼写退役：市场快照依赖项上的 `optional`（`PackageDependency.optional`）和应用安装清单上的裸 id 列表（`AppManifest.dependencies`）。两者都改为 `retiredKey()` 墓碑，写了就报错并给出改法；ADR-0141 §D8 补一条带日期的实测结论。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0141 D8 把这两个键的去留交给「实测读者数」决定。实测两者在 `packages/spec` 之外都是 0 个读者、0 个写者（本仓 packages/ui/examples/apps 与 HotCRM）。安装前检查只读 `manifest.dependencies`，且每条都必需；留着这两个键，作者（尤其 AI）写了也不生效、也不报错。
- **风险与回滚**：运行时行为不变（本来就没人读）。风险只在仓外未测到的读者：`@objectstack/spec` 是已发布包，cloud 控制面如何解析 `manifest_json` 本仓读不到。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-version.zod.ts`（`optional` 墓碑与说明）；② `docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md` §D8 新增的 Addendum 段；③ `packages/spec/src/marketplace/dependency-spellings-retirement.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/marketplace/dependency-spellings-retirement.test.ts`，预期 14 个测试全过；在 `main` 上同一文件 12 个失败。
- **需要你做的**：本 PR 改了 `docs/adr/**`（Tier H），需要你批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

What an author sees change, in plain sentences:

- Writing `optional` on a dependency entry of a package version snapshot (`PackageManifestSchema.dependencies[]`, the `PackageDependency` shape) is now refused, whatever the value, including the old default `false`. The refusal reads: "`PackageDependency.optional` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, ADR-0141 D8) — no install path ever honoured it: the pre-install check reads the package's `manifest.dependencies` record, which has no optional arm, and treats every entry as required. Delete the key. Declare a dependency in `manifest.dependencies` (`{ 'com.acme.core': '^1.0.0' }`) only when the package cannot install without it."
- Writing `dependencies` on an app install manifest (`AppManifestSchema`) is now refused the same way, including the old default `[]`. The refusal reads: "`AppManifest.dependencies` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, ADR-0141 D8) — nothing read it: it listed bare ids with no version range, and no install path consulted it. Delete the key. Declare each dependency with its range in the package's `manifest.dependencies` (`{ 'com.acme.core': '^1.0.0' }`), which the pre-install check enforces."
- In TypeScript, both keys are typed as the retired mark, so writing either fails `tsc` at the authoring site.
- A parsed entry or manifest no longer carries the key: `PackageDependencyParsed` loses `optional`, and `AppManifestParsed` loses `dependencies`.
- The manifest record `manifest.dependencies` is unchanged and stays the one way to declare a dependency.

The retirement kit, per the `spec-property-retirement` playbook:

- Schemas: `retiredKey()` on `PackageDependencySchema.optional` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-version.zod.ts`) and `AppManifestSchema.dependencies` (`packages/spec/src/system/app-install.zod.ts`), with comments naming ADR-0141 D8 and the measurement.
- ADR-0087: `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains `marketplace/PackageDependency:optional` and `system/AppManifest:dependencies` (one file each under `migrations/entries/retired-keys/`). One D3 semantic entry for the family, `dependency-unread-spellings-retired`, and its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment in `registry.ts.template`. **No D2 conversion**: neither shape is a stack collection member, so a conversion would have no seam that runs (the `kernel/Manifest:capabilities` precedent, recorded in its retired-key entry).
- The residue stage `acceptRetiredDefaultResidue` is **not** adopted, although both keys carried a default: no producer in this repository or HotCRM parses either schema to emit one, so there is no emitted population (reasoning written on both retired-key entries).
- Regenerated: `authorable-surface/{marketplace,system}.json` (each row gains `[RETIRED]`), `authorable-defaults/{marketplace,system}.json` (the two default rows leave), and the two reference pages under `content/docs/references/`, through `check:generated --fix`. `authorable-surface.base.json`, `api-surface/` and `json-schema.manifest/` do not move (a key-level tombstone keeps the def and the export).
- Fixtures: three spec tests authored a retired key (`system/app-install.test.ts`, `contracts/app-lifecycle-service.test.ts`, `kernel/package-dependency-dual-source.test.ts`). Each now writes the live shape, and the dual-source pin notes that `optional` stays in the shape as a tombstone.
- ADR-0141 §D8 gains a dated addendum naming the counts and the fates (Tier H).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO table, ADR-0087 marker `registered dependency-unread-spellings-retired`.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/marketplace/dependency-spellings-retirement.test.ts`, 14 tests, in the `repo` project (`vitest.repo-tests.json`), because its absence pin walks outside the package. It pins the refusal (`code`, `path`, prescription text) for every value of each key, the snapshot path `['dependencies', 1, 'optional']`, the controls (no key ⇒ parse passes and grows no key), the `tsc` channel (`@ts-expect-error` on each key, compiled by `tsconfig.test.json`), the registry rows and the D3 entry, that no conversion names either surface, and a tree-scoped absence pin over the five declared roots with a shape matcher (`optional` beside `versionRange`; `dependencies` beside `minKernelVersion` or `hasSeedData`) and its own anti-vacuity cases.
- Red first: the new file on `main` `6390fe52ce` gave **12 failed | 2 passed**. The two that passed are the matcher's anti-vacuity case and the no-conversion case. The absence pin's red named exactly five authoring sites, all inside `packages/spec`: the two schemas and the three tests fixed here.
- After the change: the new file plus the three edited tests, `src/marketplace/` and `scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts`: 10 files, 124 tests passed. The new file under `--project repo`: 14 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 727 passed, Tests 21998 passed | 1 todo (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (the test layer compiles under `tsconfig.test.json`; `test-typecheck-debt.json` unchanged).
- No separate ablation: the change is the tombstones themselves, and the red-first run on `main` is the run without them.

## Acceptance notes

- **The counts behind the fates**, measured at `origin/main` `6390fe52ce`. `optional` on a dependency entry: 0 readers and 0 writers outside `packages/spec` (`packages/`, `ui/`, `examples/`, `apps/`). `AppManifestSchema` / `AppManifest`: no import outside `packages/spec` at all, so 0 readers of `dependencies`. The only non-spec mentions were prose (ADR-0141, ADR-0027's table, a comment in `packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`). HotCRM at `9464673`: 0 of either; its three module manifests (`src/service`, `src/marketing`, `src/revenue`) declare `{ 'app.objectstack.hotcrm': '^6.0.0' }` in the record, the live control. `IAppLifecycleService` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/app-lifecycle-service.ts`), the one contract that takes an `AppManifest`, has no implementer in this repository.
- **What a snapshot carries.** Today a published snapshot carries the record shape, since `publish.ts` uploads the compiled artifact as it is (ADR-0141 D8 item 1), so no stored or produced snapshot changes. The addendum states the consequence for D8 item 1's future conversion (its own card): the projection writes `packageId` and `versionRange` only, never `optional`. The seat should read this against that card before landing.
- **Not measured:** the cloud control plane's parse of `sys_package_version.manifest_json` (`objectstack-ai/cloud`, not readable from this session), and any other out-of-repo consumer of the published `@objectstack/spec`.
- **Overlap with #26000.** That card (open, `pm:retriage`) proposed retiring the whole of `PackageDependencySchema` plus `AppManifestSchema.dependencies`. This PR retires only the two keys ADR-0141 D8 owed to this card. The rest of `PackageDependencySchema` stays, as D8's projection requires.
- `AppManifestSchema` as a whole (and `IAppLifecycleService`) has no reader outside `packages/spec` either. That is outside item 6 and is noted here, not changed.
- Open PRs touching the same files: #26159 and #26138 both edit `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json` (a generated, driver-merged shard). A driver-free `merge-tree` in a throwaway bare clone answers exit 0 with a tree id for both pairs, so both merge clean.
